AboutFoundingStory.Tagline: From 1938 to eternity: Preserving history while engineering a future of unity and progress.
AboutFoundingStory.ParagraphHtml: {branding.institutionName}, Munshiganj, established on 18 December 1938, stands as the premier cradle of knowledge with a visionary donation of ₹1,00,000 from the legendary philanthropist Mr. Ashutosh Ganguly. Named after his parents, Haranath Ganguly and Gangaswari Devi, the institution was built to serve generations and was inaugurated by Sher-e-Bangla A.K. Fazlul Huq. Over eight decades, it has produced visionaries who have shaped the destiny of our nation.
